newsitem.title: USA: Florida Gaming buys World Jai-Alai.
newsitem.headline: Florida Gaming buys World Jai-Alai.

text.p: Florida Gaming Corp. Tuesday said it has finalised an agreement to buy World Jai-Alai, making it the largest poker room operator in Florida and the largest jai-alai operator in the world.
Florida Gaming said it acquired $21 million of World Jai-Alai's bank debt some time ago. Under the latest deal, it agreed to forgive that debt and agreed to profit-sharing over a 10-year period.
The deal is due to close Dec. 31, subject to the transfer of gambling permits from World Jai-Alai to Fort Pierce, Fla.-based Florida Gaming by state regulators.
Florida Gaming said its total money wagered is expected to increase more than 12 times from its present level of $25 million per year to about $300 million per year.
Florida Gaming's stock rose 62.5 cents to $6.625 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
